notes.title: Playtest is Now Available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It’s been a while since I last posted about Iron Vulture, and I want to thank you all for your patience. This game has been in development since 2017, and it’s been a journey filled with highs and lows. I know I’ve mentioned in the past that it would be ready soon, but things didn’t go as planned. I’m really sorry for the delays.

But today, I’m excited to share that we finally have an early version of the game — an unfinished demo (Alpha version) — ready for you to try! 🎉

[h3]What to expect:[/h3]
[list]
[*] This is an early version of the game, so some features are still missing (for example, there’s no sound yet, and some of the content is still limited).
[*] The UI/UX is not fully optimized, but we believe it’s at a point where you can start getting a feel for the gameplay and enjoy the core mechanics.
[/list]

[b]Your feedback matters:[/b]
I’d love for you all to try it out and let us know your thoughts. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we plan to use it to continue improving the game over multiple iterations as we work towards the full Steam release.

So, if you can, please give this version a shot and share your opinions. It would mean the world to us! 🙏

Thanks again for your continued support. I can’t wait to hear what you think and continue this journey together!

[b]The playtest is available now on Steam[/b]

Join the Discord Server to share your thought with us:
